items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to Atkinson and Shiffrin's multi-store model — sensory, short-term and long-term stores.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: BBC Radio 4 series exploring memory research including the classic store-based models and their real-world applications.

items.title: Multi-Store Model of Memory Explained — Atkinson and Shiffrin
items.description: Detailed walkthrough of the three stores — coding, capacity and duration of sensory register, STM and LTM — matched to AQA GCSE content.

items.title: How We Make Memories: Crash Course Psychology #13
items.description: Covers the encoding and storage stages of the multi-store model alongside the neuroscience of memory formation.

items.title: The Case Study of HM and the Multi-Store Model of Memory
items.description: Patient HM's hippocampal surgery provided key evidence for separate STM and LTM stores — central to evaluating the model.

items.title: Memento
items.description: Thriller about a man who cannot form new short-term memories — a powerful illustration of what happens when the STM-to-LTM transfer process breaks down.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Multi-Store Memory Model
items.description: Detailed notes on Atkinson and Shiffrin's model including evaluation points — the standard revision reference for this topic.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Working Memory Model
items.description: Notes on Baddeley and Hitch's working memory model — useful for comparing with and evaluating the multi-store model.
